How a test fixture flipped core.bare

On 2026-09-12 orchestkit's .git/config acquired core.bare = true three times, always during a push. The writer was an ordinary git init in a temp dir, run by a test inside the pre-push hook. Pick where the push ran from and whether the hook scrubs its inherited git variables.
